description:
FILED s543q (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-28, CODE 6a1301ed = MAIN-READY-114 + records, v2-16500) by the Rosetta census B (docs/rosetta-plan.md section 6b; #2104).

THE SHAPE (neutral reproducer, run on the tree, perl 5.40.3 vs PCL):

    use POSIX qw(getenv INFINITY);
    print defined(getenv("PATH")) ? "set" : "unset", " ", (INFINITY > 1e308 ? "inf" : "finite"), "\n";

    perl: set inf
    PCL : "getenv" is not exported by the POSIX module
          "INFINITY" is not exported by the POSIX module
          Can't continue after import errors at .../lib/POSIX.pm line 43.     (exit 255)

THE GAP, measured: perl 5.40.3's POSIX @EXPORT + @EXPORT_OK hold 766 names, the shim's 191.  Most of the 575 missing are the ruled-out families (termios, SigSet, sysconf/_SC_*, the stdio and string.h names perl itself refuses) or perl builtins POSIX re-exports (abs, exp, sqrt -- they work without it); the ones a pure-computation program meets are `getenv`, the C99 float constants `INFINITY` `NAN` `Inf` `NaN` `HUGE_VAL` `FP_*` `M_*`, and the C99 math functions (`isfinite` `fpclassify` `acosh` `asinh` `atanh` `erf` `erfc` `exp2` `expm1` `log1p` `lgamma` `rint` `lrint` `nextafter` `scalbn` `ilogb` `logb` `j0` `j1` `jn` ...).  `INFINITY` is `9**9**9`, `NAN` its difference with itself; `getenv(NAME)` is `$ENV{NAME}`.
WHERE: the shim (rule 9a, lib/ layer); not-supported.md "POSIX" says the shim is "perl's own default export list restricted to what it implements" -- these names are neither implemented nor ruled out.

CHEAP DISCRIMINATING MEASUREMENT (taken): 1049 with `use constant INFINITY => 9**9**9;` in place of the import is byte-identical to perl (its only cause); 0399 is two lines and has no other statement.

PROGRAMS: 0399-Environment-variables, 1049-Posit-numbers-encoding.
subject: LOUD: lib/POSIX.pm lacks `getenv` and the C99 constants `INFINITY` / `NAN` -- `use POSIX 'getenv'` and `use POSIX qw(INFINITY)` die at import "\"getenv\" is not exported by the POSIX module"; neither is in not-supported.md's list of ruled-out POSIX names (Rosetta 0399 1049)
triage_reason: POSIX is a shipped shim, IN by docs/supported-subset.md section 3; getenv and INFINITY are pure computation (no libc state), not among ns-posix's ruled-out syscalls
